posts.text: [Image] A four-image collage documents damage at the Reflecting Pool. It shows peeling and cracked coating along the pool edge, dark spray-painted outlines and turquoise resurfacing on the basin, a highlighted passage describing a defendant allegedly tearing the blue coating, and an aerial view of the rectangular lawn and surrounding construction area. Trees, pathways, equipment, and workers’ materials are visible.
